scripts.build:pages: pnpm --filter @w1c/docs build && W1C_STORYBOOK_BASE=/storybook/ pnpm --filter @w1c/storybook exec storybook build --output-dir ../docs/build/storybook
scripts.deploy:pages: pnpm build:pages && pnpm exec wrangler pages deploy packages/docs/build --project-name w1c
scripts.deploy:pages:preview: pnpm build:pages && pnpm exec wrangler pages deploy packages/docs/build --project-name w1c --branch preview
